# Welcome to my website!

Hi! I’m Fanyun Fang, a research technician at CWRU pharmacology department with a background in biology and medical physiology and a strong interest in neuroscience and biomedical research. I’m especially fascinated by the brain, behavior, and the biological mechanisms that shape human health.

Outside of research, I’m an animal lover and a proud pet parent to three cats and a snake. When I’m not in the lab, you’ll usually find me reading, discovering new music, or spending time with my pets. I enjoy exploring new ideas through both science and literature, and I’m always curious about the world around me.
Please feel free to [contact me](fxf116@case.edu) if you have any questions or would like to discuss potential projects.
